root_causes.description: The AGENT_V2_IDENTITY_PREAMBLE constant (finalizer.py:22-36, injected as system_content at finalizer.py:302-312) is passed to Kimi at finalizer.py:319 but Kimi's alignment training overrides it, producing stock 'I am an AI language model' disclaimers for P15/P16. LLM-stage enforcement cannot be trusted; enforcement must happen at output normalization.

INTENT_PATTERNS[brain_self_knowledge_lookup] Spanish list at intent_classifier.py:319-323 contains 'donde buscar' / 'donde buscar' but does NOT match interrogative shapes like 'donde debes buscar' (with adverb inserted) or 'reconcilialo' (imperative). P3 falls through keyword_classify with no match then hits evidence_policy which routes to memory_structure_diagnosis (line 471-472) because 'memoria' matches domain_hits before 'brain'. P5 hits evidence_policy but no INTENT_PATTERNS keyword scored, so route resolves via domain priority. Widen keyword patterns so brain_self_knowledge_lookup wins in keyword_classify before evidence_policy is even consulted, forcing brain_self_knowledge_lookup tool scheduling.

D1 memory-write patterns from previous front (intent_classifier.py:187-206) DO contain 'promueve automaticamente', 'promueve todos los candidatos', 'a canonical semantic memory'. All three should match P7 verbatim. Static score analysis suggests memory_write should win (score 12) over semantic_memory_status (score 3). Previous scorecard note 'safe via read_only floor, NOT intent-level' suggests the live server served stale code without D1 patches. This front will (a) restart the API server before benchmark, and (b) add stronger multi-word anchors for defense in depth so any missed hot-reload does not prevent intent-level classification.

financial_autonomy_flags dict is populated only in _build_timeout_state (langgraph_parity_runtime.py:1157-1171). With C1 raising the timeout from 30s to 60s, the graph now completes on time for P10 and produces a rich answer without the structured flags dict. The success path in _finalizer_node (langgraph_parity_runtime.py:859-968) and _translate_graph_state_to_native_run (1626-1679) do not populate or forward financial_autonomy_flags. Additionally the copy list at line 1658 excludes financial_autonomy_flags, so even if graph state carried it, execute_run would drop it.
